## Our Team

We are a group of students in the DSML course working together on our final project.
This website introduces our team and each member.

## Members

### Jimmy Yu

Hi, I'm Jimmy Yu (于京田). I'm an undergraduate at the University of Richmond, majoring in
Business Administration and Chinese Studies / International Business, and I'm spending
Fall 2026 as an exchange student at NCCU's College of Commerce in Taipei.

Outside of class I enjoy building things with code: I run my own home server, make small
games, and experiment with AI tools. I'm looking forward to learning more about data
science and machine learning with this team.
